data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'A-M-R', meaning 'to command'. A name for a brave and strong individual in Islam. The name Amro carries the meaning “Brave, Strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amro usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
